prompt: As of August 3, 2024, what is the hometown of the captain of the team that won the Stanley Cup three years before 2017?
answer: The 2014 Stanley Cup-winning team was the **Los Angeles Kings**, whose captain was **Dustin Brown**. His hometown is **Ithaca, New York**.
